scope: One bounded data-expansion experiment, same initializer and training settings as v22. TRAIN grows from97 to111; equal epochs are not equal optimizer steps or wall clock. Existing full13 VAL remains checkpoint selection only.

trials.name: baseline
trials.hypothesis: Fourteen independently sourced reviewed TRAIN images add small/background/occluded containers and cut/nonliving confusers. Test whether these improve frozen full-target VAL; no generalization improvement is assumed.

observed_v23_test_policy: Previously evaluated v23 data can only be a labeled observed regression diagnostic after freezing a candidate; never use it to choose thresholds or checkpoints. Any future acceptance requires another fresh independent source/session test and PICO validation.
